title: flight-kinnex-qc: Kinnex array integrity in FLIGHT-seq libraries
description: The code and results behind the FLIGHT-seq manuscript's Supplementary Note on Kinnex array integrity: what goes wrong when PacBio's Kinnex 8-fold kit joins single-cell cDNA molecules into arrays, how often, and how many usable molecules it costs. It also installs kinnex-qc, a command that checks the array structure and artifact molecules (TSO-TSO, R1-R1, missing primers) in Kinnex HiFi reads and, with skera's S-reads, skera's cuts.
